# Set Do Not Disturb

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the devices Do Not Disturb to the given boolean.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setDND(state: <#BoolNumb#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setDND(state: false)
~~~~
